comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured

lines.statement: Not available: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Sixth Avenue MRT about 900 m, Holland Village MRT about 1,460 m; closer than 10 of 551 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Henry Park Primary School about 1,200 m; more than 0 of 551 similar developments (the same as 106). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 1 supermarket within 1 km (nearest about 860 m), more than 4 of 551 similar developments (the same as 29); nearest hawker centre Holland Village Market And Food Centre about 1,440 m; nearest park Holland Green Linear Park about 500 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Holland Village Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming on the Cross Island Line: Maju MRT about 1,700 m (LTA target 2032) and Turf City MRT about 1,810 m (LTA target 2032), both under construction. Straight-line distances to the planned station sites; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Amberwood at Holland, 24 new sales, about 700 m; Dunearn House, 237 new sales, about 1,090 m; Skye at Holland, 666 new sales, about 1,290 m; Pinetree Hill, 58 new sales, about 1,850 m; Nava Grove, 77 new sales, about 1,980 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 101 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,062 new sales and 410 resales (1,472 purchases); new sales were 72.1% of these purchases. Subsales (22) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Holland Plain GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 790 m; Dunearn Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,150 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 410 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 88 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 410 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 405 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (+1.2%). Planning-area private resales −4.6%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
